summary: Checks and builds a mod: Check in a fresh worker, Build in a bounded child process that stages, packs once, verifies and promotes, one of each at a time.

faults.when: Settings, WolvenKit or the eye plate aren't ready; the refusal names the one next step.
A compiler or verifier gate failed; nothing is promoted.
The run passed its deadline; a stale prerequisite gets one retry with the remaining time.

lifetime: Per request; one Check and one Build at a time per host.

x-friction.gap: Each run has a deadline, and a retry gets the remaining time.
x-friction.closes: Deadline-bound work with its own abort reason and the remaining budget carried to a retry.

x-friction.gap: Build takes seconds to minutes and publishes no progress; the page can't cancel it.
x-friction.closes: Progress streamed from host work, and cancellation by asking.
